# Root Computers (روت)

> Root (rootjo.com) is an online computer store in Jordan. It sells new laptops (in box, with the maker's or supplier's warranty) and used laptops in excellent condition (2-month warranty), plus desktops, monitors and genuine Windows and Microsoft Office licenses, and offers repair and upgrades. Delivery covers all of Jordan (3 JD in Amman, 5 JD elsewhere) and customers pay on delivery after checking the device. Most Windows laptops come with genuine Windows 11 Pro and Microsoft Office Pro Plus and a free bag and wireless mouse (each product page lists what is included).

روت متجر إلكتروني أردني للابتوبات والكمبيوترات الجديدة والمستعملة. الأجهزة المستعملة بكفالة شهرين، والجديدة بكفالتها. توصيل لكل المملكة (3 دنانير داخل عمّان و5 خارجها) والدفع عند الاستلام بعد المعاينة.

## Policies

- [Warranty policy](https://rootjo.com/warranty): used devices 2 months; new devices carry the warranty stated on each product page.
- [Customer feedback](https://rootjo.com/feedback): real messages from customers.
- Ordering: choose a device on the site and order on WhatsApp, or request any model and Root sources it.

## Sections

- [Laptops](https://rootjo.com/laptops): New in box and used in excellent condition, each with a clear warranty.
- [Desktops](https://rootjo.com/desktops): Ready-made desktops, or one built to your budget.
- [Monitors](https://rootjo.com/monitors): New-in-box monitors with warranty.
- [Software licenses](https://rootjo.com/licenses): Genuine Windows, Office and Microsoft 365, with the key sent right after payment.
- [Repair & setup](https://rootjo.com/repair): Diagnosis, repair, upgrades and setup for your device, with the cost quoted before any work.
